dialogue.origin: (おはようございます。よろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきます。)
dialogue.content: (Good morning. Thank you for joining me. We'll get started, as it's our scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。年齢・性別・相談したいことを、教えてください。
dialogue.content: Hello. I am your counselor. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。よろしくお願いします。40代女　20歳の娘についてです
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for seeing me. I'm a woman in my 40s, and I'd like to talk about my 20-year-old daughter.

dialogue.origin: 教えてくれて、ありがとうございます。娘さんのことですね。どんなことですか。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me. So, it's about your daughter. What's on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 娘が3月に大学をやめました。高校2年頃から不登校になり、通信制に編入して、大学進学して、そのときまでは良かったんですけど、また昨年夏ごろから大学に行けなくなり、もうやめたいと言うことで退学しました。最近は昼まで寝ていることも多く、外出もほとんどしません。主人との折り合いも悪いです。このままの生活を続けていて良くないことはわかっているのですが、どうしたらよいでしょうか
dialogue.content: My daughter withdrew from university in March. She stopped attending school around her second year of high school, so she transferred to a correspondence school. She then went on to university, and things were fine until then, but around last summer, she stopped being able to go to university again. She said she wanted to quit, so she dropped out. Lately, she often sleeps until noon and hardly ever goes out. She also doesn't get along with my husband. I know it's not good for her to continue living like this, but what should I do?

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。ご心配ですね。今までも、いろいろあったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very worrying for you. It sounds like you've been through a lot up to now.

dialogue.origin: 昨年夏頃行けなくなったとのこと。何かきっかけなどありましたか。
dialogue.content: You mentioned she stopped being able to go around last summer. Was there any particular trigger?

dialogue.origin: 聞いても教えてくれません。ただ、昔から神経質なところがあるので、友だちとの関係に苦労していたことはあります。
dialogue.content: She won't tell me even when I ask. However, she has always been a bit sensitive, and she has struggled with friendships in the past.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。そんな娘さんを、見守ってきたのですね。ご不安もご苦労もあったでしょう。
dialogue.content: I understand. You've been watching over your daughter through all of this. It must have been very anxious and difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: 高校生のとき行けなくなったのも、友だち関係が関係していた様子でしょうか。
dialogue.content: When she had difficulty attending school in high school, do you think it was also related to her friendships?

dialogue.origin: 詳しくは教えてくれませんが、そうなんじゃないかと思っています。通信制のときはアルバイトもして楽しそうにしていただけに大丈夫だと思っていましたが見積もりが甘かったです
dialogue.content: She won't tell me the details, but I suspect so. When she was at the correspondence school, she even had a part-time job and seemed to be enjoying herself, so I thought she would be okay, but I guess I was too optimistic.

dialogue.origin: 話してくれないと、よけいに心配が募りますよね。それでも、通信制編入を親子で決断されたのですね。そして、おそらく通信制は居心地がよかった…。アルバイトも経験できたこと、よかったですよね。
dialogue.content: It must make you worry even more when she doesn't talk about it. Still, you both made the decision for her to transfer to the correspondence school together. And it seems like she was comfortable there... It was great that she was able to experience a part-time job, wasn't it?

dialogue.origin: いい決断でしたね。
dialogue.content: That was a good decision.

dialogue.origin: でも…なのですよね。
dialogue.content: And yet... this is the situation now.

dialogue.origin: 今、娘さんのようすを見ていると、あなたにはどんなお気持ちがあるのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Right now, when you see your daughter like this, what kinds of feelings come up for you?

dialogue.origin: 実は、娘には内緒でサポステを見学に行きました。このまま何もしないだけで時間が過ぎると余計に動きにくくなると思って。本人が動く気にならないと、とは言われましたが早すぎるでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Actually, I went to visit a Youth Support Station without telling my daughter. I'm worried that the longer she does nothing, the harder it will be for her to get moving again. They told me that she has to be motivated to take action herself, but do you think it's too soon?

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。見守る方は、気が気ではないですよね。焦りもあるでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see. It must be very stressful for the one watching over her. Do you feel a sense of urgency, perhaps?

dialogue.origin: サポステに行ってみて、どうお感じになりましたか。
dialogue.content: How did you feel after visiting the Youth Support Station?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。いつまでも面倒見れるわけではないので。説明を聞いて、娘のような経験をした人も多く通っているとききました。なので外に出るきっかけになったらいいなと思います。
dialogue.content: Well, I can't look after her forever. I listened to their explanation and heard that many young people with experiences like my daughter's go there. So I'm hoping it could be a chance for her to get out of the house.

dialogue.origin: なるほどです。娘さんは、そのことをご存じではない感じですか。
dialogue.content: I see. It seems your daughter doesn't know about it yet.

dialogue.origin: まだ言ってないです
dialogue.content: I haven't told her yet.

dialogue.origin: 少し前にアルバイトをしてみたら？って言ったんです。そのときはそうだね、みたいな感じだったんですけど、それから動く気配がなくて
dialogue.content: A little while ago, I suggested, 'Why don't you try getting a part-time job?'. At the time, she was like, 'Yeah, maybe,' but she hasn't shown any signs of taking action since.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。あなたから働きかけはするものの…なのですね。少し整理させてくださいね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you're making efforts to reach out, but nothing comes of it. Let me try to summarize the situation.

dialogue.origin: 20歳の娘さん。通信制では楽しく過ごせていたものの、台閣はいきづらくなり、退学を選ぶ。最近は昼まで寝ていることも多く、外出もほとんどしない。夫さんとの折り合いも悪い状況。あなたご自身は、サポステなど、行動をおこしてみているものの、娘さんの反応は芳しくはない。
dialogue.content: So, your 20-year-old daughter. Although she seemed to be doing well at the correspondence school, university became difficult for her, and she chose to drop out. Lately, she often sleeps until noon and rarely goes out. She also doesn't get along with your husband. You yourself have started to take action, like visiting the Youth Support Station, but your daughter's response has not been positive.

dialogue.origin: というご様子なのですよね。
dialogue.content: That seems to be the situation, is that correct?

dialogue.origin: ごめんなさい。大学…です。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry. I meant university.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: そんな中、今日ご相談くださったのは、何を一番相談したかったですか。
dialogue.content: Given all that, what was the main thing you wanted to consult about today?

dialogue.origin: サポステの見学に連れて行くのはどうでしょうか
dialogue.content: I was wondering what you think about taking her to visit the Youth Support Station.

dialogue.origin: まずは、そうお考えなのですね。何か、とっかかりになれば…と願いますものね。サポステさんが言われる、本人が動く気になる…というところ、なにか案がありそうですか。
dialogue.content: So that's what you're considering first. You're hoping it would be a starting point for her, aren't you? Regarding what the people at the Support Station said—about her needing to be motivated herself—do you have any ideas about that?

dialogue.origin: それがわかりません
dialogue.content: That's what I don't know.

dialogue.origin: 難しいところですよね。親子とはいえ、娘さんの気持ちを動かすとなると…ですよね。
dialogue.content: That is a difficult part, isn't it? Even as her parent, when it comes to motivating her... it's not so simple.

dialogue.origin: これは、こんな視点もあるのでは…という、ご提案ではあるのですが…
dialogue.content: This is just a suggestion, but perhaps there's another way to look at this...

dialogue.origin: これは、こんな視点もあるのでは…というご提案なのですが…
dialogue.content: This is a suggestion—perhaps there’s another perspective to consider…

dialogue.origin: (すいません！システムが反応していないです)
dialogue.content: (Sorry! The system isn't responding.)

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: （あ、送れました！）
dialogue.content: (Ah, it went through!)

dialogue.origin: これは、こんな視点もあるかな…というご提案ではあるのですが…
dialogue.content: This is a suggestion—perhaps there’s another perspective to consider…

dialogue.origin: 娘さんの気持ちを動かすのは、確かに難しい。でも、娘さんのエネルギーがたまってくれば、娘さんがあなたの提案に反応する可能性は出てくる…
dialogue.content: It is certainly difficult to motivate your daughter. But, if her energy is replenished, the possibility that she will respond to your suggestions may increase...

dialogue.origin: 今の娘さんのエネルギー充電度は、どれくらいなのでしょうね。
dialogue.content: I wonder what your daughter's energy level is like right now.

dialogue.origin: 日々ご一緒に過ごされていて、どう感じられますか。
dialogue.content: Spending time with her every day, what is your sense of it?

dialogue.origin: 元気そうにしていたときと比べると落ちてますね、確実に
dialogue.content: Compared to when she seemed energetic, it's definitely lower.

dialogue.origin: そうお感じなのですね。親としては、つらいですね。ならば、もしかしたら今娘さんは、
dialogue.content: That's how it feels to you. As a parent, that must be painful. In that case, perhaps right now your daughter is...

dialogue.origin: 安全なお家とあなたの見守りのもとで、エネルギーを充電しているところなのかもしれない。そう考えると、遠回りかもしれないですが、エネルギー充電のために、あなたが今できることを考えて見るのも、ひとつかな…と思います。
dialogue.content: ...recharging her energy in the safety of home and under your watchful care. If we think of it that way, it may feel roundabout, but perhaps one approach is to consider what you can do now to support that recharging.

dialogue.origin: 何か、ありそうでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Does anything come to mind?

dialogue.origin: そんなことあるのでしょうか
dialogue.content: Is that really possible?

dialogue.origin: いくつか提案してみても、よいですか。いまいちなところは、どうぞ聞き流してくださいね。少しでもお役に立てば…と思って、試しに伝えてみますね。
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I make a few suggestions? Please feel free to disregard any that don't seem right. I'll just offer them in the hope that they might be of some help.

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: まずは、雑談から…は、ひとつかなと思います。エネルギーが低下しているところに、本題に迫る話があると、お互いのエネルギーが、さらにとられてしまいます。そう…
dialogue.content: First, starting with small talk might be one option. When energy is low, diving into the main issue can drain both of your energy even more. So…

dialogue.origin: あなたのエネルギーも…なのですよね。だいじなポイントなのかもしれないです。何でもいいので、あなたも娘さんもここちよく感じる会話を、今は重ねていくときなのかもしれません。
dialogue.content: ...your energy as well. That might be an important point. It could be that now is the time to build up conversations that feel comfortable for both you and your daughter, about anything at all.

dialogue.origin: どんなことでもいいんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Can it be about anything?

dialogue.origin: もちろんです。雑談ですもの。なにか思いつくこと、ありますか。
dialogue.content: Of course. It’s just small talk. Does anything come to mind?

dialogue.origin: 一緒にテレビを見ているときにそのテレビの話をするとかですか？
dialogue.content: Like, talking about the TV show while we're watching it together?

dialogue.origin: いいですね。楽しそう。あと、今日はいいお天気だね。ご飯、何食べたい？今日の目玉焼き、めっちゃいい感じにできたよ…とか、どうでしょう。
dialogue.content: That's great. It sounds fun. Also, how about things like, 'It's nice weather today, isn't it?', 'What do you want to eat?', or 'My fried egg today turned out perfectly!'?

dialogue.origin: そして、あなたはもうすでにやっておられるように(サポステにいってみたように)
dialogue.content: And then, as you are already doing (like how you went to the Youth Support Station)...

dialogue.origin: あなたなりに情報を集めておく…というのは、ひとつ大事なところかもしれないと感じました。
dialogue.content: ...I feel it might also be important for you to continue gathering information in your own way.

dialogue.origin: そういうことでいいんですね。確かに主人と折り合いが悪くなったことで会話が減ってました
dialogue.content: So that kind of thing is okay. It's true that since she started not getting along with my husband, our conversations have decreased.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんとあなたのエネルギーがたまってくる中で、きっとその情報たちは、役に立つ時が来ると思います。
dialogue.content: As your and your daughter's energy levels build up, I'm sure the time will come when that information will be useful.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。夫さんとのことも、気にされていましたものね。まずは、
dialogue.content: I see. You were concerned about her relationship with your husband, too. For now,

dialogue.origin: 夫さんはいったんおいておいて、あなたと娘さんが…で、いいと思います。同じ空間にいれば、やがてその空気は、夫さんにも伝わっていくと思います。
dialogue.content: I think it's fine to set your husband aside for now and focus on you and your daughter. If you are in the same space, that atmosphere will eventually carry over to your husband as well.

dialogue.origin: ここまでお話しされてみて、いかがですか。
dialogue.content: How are you feeling now that we've talked this far?

dialogue.origin: やってみたいと思います。ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: I’d like to give it a try. Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: また相談に来てもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May I come back for another consultation?

dialogue.origin: こちらこそです。もちろんです！今日はありがとうございました。また、いつでもお話にいらしてくださいね。一緒に考えていきたいです。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. Of course! Thank you for today. Please feel free to come and talk anytime. I'd like to continue thinking about this together with you.

dialogue.origin: それでは、終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.content: Then, we’ll end here for today.

dialogue.origin: わかりました。本日はアドバイスありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Understood. Thank you for your advice today.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございました。お疲れ様でした！)
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much. Thank you for your time today!)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

topic.sub: 娘とのコミュニケーション問題
